# Munali Shakya

> Backend engineer building production APIs, cloud infrastructure and AI integrations with C#, ASP.NET Core, AWS, Terraform and Temporal. Available for remote work worldwide.

## Quick answers
- Who is Munali Shakya? A backend engineer from Nepal. Currently an Associate Software Engineer at Proventus Analytics.
- What does Munali work with? C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, SQL Server, MongoDB, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, Temporal workflows, Auth0, Stripe and the OpenAI SDK.
- Where has Munali worked? Spiralogics International (.NET Intern, Feb to Apr 2025), then Proventus Analytics (Software Engineer Intern, now Associate Software Engineer).
- Is Munali available for work? Yes, for remote roles and projects worldwide.
- How can I contact Munali? Use the contact form at https://munali.com.np/#contact, email munali.shakya@gmail.com, or message on LinkedIn.

- Associate Software Engineer, Proventus Analytics (current): REST APIs in C# and ASP.NET Core, AWS infrastructure with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, MongoDB, Auth0, Stripe, Temporal workflows, OpenAI SDK features.
- Software Engineer Intern, Proventus Analytics: C# API development, unit testing, internal tool APIs, AWS S3 integrations.
- .NET Intern, Spiralogics International (Feb to Apr 2025, first internship): full-stack ASP.NET MVC features in C# and SQL Server, Clean Architecture, Hangfire background jobs, Chart.js dashboards, code reviews and team deadlines.
